verdict.rationale: Devin is documented as a conversational interface. Users give it tasks in plain language through the web app, by tagging it in Slack or Teams threads, through the CLI (e.g. `devin -- check out this code and suggest a feasible, helpful feature`), and through Ask Devin for code Q&A and planning. Hands-on users confirm they steer it by typing a few lines. Missing for 10: reliable follow-through on corrective natural-language instructions, since one hands-on report says it could not undo its changes when asked.
